services.name: Muskie Fishing
services.desc: The Whopper Stopper can meet your every fishing needs. Whether it's a large party charter or small group muskie hunt our charters will put you in the hottest fishing spots with the best equipment and knowledgeable crew. The Captain can accommodate very large parties by providing extra boats if need be. Please inquire when scheduling your fishing trip of a lifetime! Put the Muskie odds in your Favor with the "Big Ripper". Get discounts for multiple days while increasing your chances at those magic days. Muskie fishing is all about time on the water.
